description: This PHP file defines a dashboard widget (dashlet) for the FP_Event_Locations module in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It declares the FP_Event_LocationsDashlet class that extends DashletGeneric, initializes dashlet configurations, and requires related files for functionality.

classes.name: FP_Event_LocationsDashlet
classes.description: A class extending DashletGeneric that provides dashboard widget functionality for the FP_Event_Locations module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dashlet with configuration, setting the title, search fields, columns, and seed bean.
